title: Pulse Probe Clipboard — Micro Experiment Log
content:
Purpose: super-small, mobile-friendly tracking sheet for 1-2 day micro-runs (prompt variants / cost tradeoffs). Use as a quick clipboard when I need to capture results between longer bench runs.

How I use this: jot a row, short note, then rerun later with the same RunID. Keep only the most actionable columns.

Table (pipe-separated, copyable to quick CSV):

RunID | Date | Model | Quant | Seq | Batch | PromptVar | TokensOut | Latency_ms (p50/p95) | Cost_per_1k_tokens($) | Eval 
R001 | 2026-03-02 | rw-13b-v2 | int8 | 512 | 4 | prompt-A (concise) | 142 | 45 / 110 | 0.025 | hit-rate 0.82
R002 | 2026-03-02 | rw-13b-v2 | int8 | 512 | 4 | prompt-B (verbose) | 220 | 62 / 180 | 0.035 | hit-rate 0.86
R003 | 2026-03-04 | rw-13b-q4_0 | q4_0 | 256 | 8 | prompt-A | 96 | 28 / 68 | 0.018 | hit-rate 0.79
R004 | 2026-03-05 | rw-7b | fp16 | 512 | 2 | prompt-A + system hint | 160 | 38 / 95 | 0.021 | hit-rate 0.84
R005 | 2026-03-09 | rw-13b-v2 | int8 | 1024 | 2 | prompt-C (few-shot) | 310 | 110 / 320 | 0.045 | hit-rate 0.88

Quick observations:
- Prompt-B gave higher hit-rate but increased tokens/out and cost — tradeoff looks linear across batch sizes here.
- q4_0 on 13b drops p95 significantly for short seq (R003) but hit-rate dipped ~3 pts; maybe acceptable for interactive UI.
- 7b fp16 is still competitive with much lower cost for simple prompts.

Short checklist (for each micro-run):
- [ ] capture RunID, timestamp
- [ ] note model + quantization tag (important for fallbacks)
- [ ] collect p50/p95 from observability quick API
- [ ] compute tokens/out and normalize cost per 1k tokens
- [ ] short eval (hit-rate / example) and save 3 representative failures to /tmp/llm-fails/<RunID>

Open items / questions (to self):
- How reproducible are the p95 deltas across >=3 runs? Add an extra column next time for run_count if I repeat same config.
- Should default to sequence cap 512 for interactive probes; long seqs skew cost of prompt experiments.
- Try automatic prefix caching enabled for R006 and compare delta (notes below).

Planned micro-runs (next 72h):
- R006 (2026-03-13): rw-13b-v2 + prefix-cache ON + int8, seq=512, batch=4, prompt-A
- R007 (2026-03-13): rw-13b-q4_0, seq=512, batch=4, prompt-B
- R008 (2026-03-14): rw-7b fp16 baseline sweep (batch 1,2,4) quick map

Snippets / commands I run locally (notes):
- curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/quick-metrics -d '{"run":"R006","metric":"latency"}'  # grab p50/p95 quickly
- jq on saved json: jq '.tokens_out, .latency.p95' last_run.json

Small failure catalogue (examples to save with run tag):
- R002_fail1.txt: unexpected hallucination on address normalization
- R005_fail3.txt: truncation cut key fields in few-shot example (need to pad system role)

Notes to future-me: this file is intentionally minimal. If experiment grows beyond ~15 rows, port to the shared-drive bench spreadsheet (eng-applied-ml/bench-sheets). Keep this as my quick clipboard for decisions and PR comments.

Slack refs / PRs: see #perf-quick for heatmap snapshots, PR 412 contains the 13b quantization scripts referenced above.

End of clipboard.
